questions.text: The sum of the present ages of Stan and Benedict is 41 years. Four years ago, Benedict's age was half of Stan's age at that time. What is Stan's present age (in years)? Ans A). 36 B). 33 C). 26 D). 30 Correct Answer: C

A city's population decreases by 15% in the first year and by another 10% in the second year. In the third and fourth years, new development causes the population to grow by a constant rate of y% per year. If the population of the city, at the end of four years is 92.565% of the original size, what is the value of y? Ans A). 10 B). 20 C). 5 D). 15 Correct Answer: A
